test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find a single discount (rounded up to two decimal places) equal to three consecutive discounts of 13%, 20% and 4%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **successive discount** formula: Net Discount = a + b − (a × b ÷ 100).

For 13% and 20%: 13 + 20 − (13 × 20 ÷ 100) = 33 − 2.6 = **30.4%**.

Now combine 30.4% and 4%: 30.4 + 4 − (30.4 × 4 ÷ 100) = 34.4 − 1.216 = **33.184%**.

Rounding to two decimal places, we get **33.18%**.

**∴ The correct answer is 33.18%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Three consecutive discounts of **13%**, **20%**, and **4%**.

**Formula:** Single Discount = [1 − (1 − d₁/100)(1 − d₂/100)(1 − d₃/100)] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4a529fd8db3d981eb71d2360d76d94261c300630104b3b3cf25e984e3989c1f.png] 

⇒ Let the **Marked Price (MP)** be 100.

⇒ Price after 13% discount = 100 − 13 = 87.

⇒ Price after 20% discount = 87 − (20% of 87) = 87 − 17.4 = 69.6.

⇒ Price after 4% discount = 69.6 − (4% of 69.6) = 69.6 − 2.784 = 66.816.

⇒ Net Discount = 100 − 66.816 = 33.184%.

**∴ The correct answer is 33.18%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

When a series of discounts are applied one after another on the reducing balance, it is called a successive discount. The order of applying discounts does not change the final **Selling Price**.

Equivalent Discount Formula

For two discounts a% and b%, the single equivalent discount is (a + b − ab/100)%.</p
